## Checklist

- [ ] This follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/OpenSesame-Labs/OpenSesame/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Commits are signed, the branch is up to date with `main`, and review threads are resolved so this can squash-merge.
- [ ] Consequential decisions have an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] UI changes include measurements and review links comparing two real builds; before/after media remains temporary.
- [ ] Persisted evidence contains only approved current state under `docs/evidence/<feature>/<project>/<platform>/`, with source and approval provenance. The impacted slot replaces superseded files; unrelated slots and Git history are preserved.
- [ ] Agent-assisted work names the tool and model in the commit message or in Provenance below.

- [ ] Repository footprint checks pass; no run histories, raw review transcripts, caches or duplicate skill installations are added.
